NextItemRules: Oracle rows are the strongest route: the 6.4 released surface names them, and a literal in the 6.3 body must corroborate the row before it is accepted.
A NewName may not repeat inside one type; the sibling stays open rather than taking a numeric suffix.

Virtual rows, interface implementations and contract-family members are renamed as a family (build-rows.py fills ContractFamily; the updater expands it), so a block can grow the map by more rows than the review file holds.
One block is one review file, one --wave run, one checkpoint, one commit.

Codes: same-module name collision where the sibling has no distinct evidence
no-evidence-in-scope: every evidence route is closed for this row with a measured number (private state with no observable behaviour, no literal, no anchor, no readable counterpart)
HardBlockers.Rule: A turn may stop with work left only when every remaining row of the current block carries one of these codes, recorded here with its token. While an unmeasured route remains (see Routes), 'evidence is missing' is not accepted; switch route instead. Every code above is backed by a measured number in ExhaustedRoutes.

Closure.Rule: The pass closes when every in-scope definition sits in exactly one terminal category: named | already-readable | SDK/protected | compiler-generated | unresolved-no-evidence (each with a reason). NotYetNamedRows is a progress metric, not the goal itself.
Closure.Authority: The goal text allows this explicitly: 'Leave uncertain decisions explicitly unresolved, with a brief explanation of what evidence is missing' and 'Do not claim completion beyond the available evidence'.
Closure.Steps: 1) harvest whatever the open 6.4 anchor-fixpoint route yields; 2) record the remaining rows in the ledger with Unresolved=true and UnresolvedReason so --coverage counts them as decided; 3) run Phase 4.
Closure.NotClaimed: Closing the naming phase is not the same as a renamed or verified ETS: AppliedToSource stays false until Phase 4.

Deferred.Phase4: Freeze the map, export the source tree with dnSpy.Console --source-name-map <map> --public-sign, rebuild, overlay Stage-RecompiledTree + manifest, run the audit battery, then verify against unchanged third-party ETS Apps.
Deferred.NotProven: Mapping is not source application. AppliedToSource=false means the ETS binaries and sources are still unchanged.
